decisions.reason: These plug-ins sit squarely in the firm's core geospatial integration knowledge base, and their modular product-line character makes continued incremental improvement more likely than withdrawal.
The building data digital twin service extends existing geospatial and enterprise-integration capabilities into a growing adjacent use case that the firm's in-house R&D can continue to refine.

Authentication and identity delegation is somewhat more adjacent than the firm's core GIS offer, but it is still close enough to its software and integration competences that management would likely keep learning and adapting rather than exit now.
An open GIS application development framework is highly aligned with the firm's long-standing software, standards, and consulting expertise, so it remains a strategically important platform product.
Because this identity and access service is explicitly tailored to GIS applications, it benefits from strong related knowledge and customer fit that support continued commercialization.
The consulting workshop draws directly on the firm's established consulting, training, and geodata process know-how, making it easy to absorb feedback and adjust the offer without abandoning it.
